name: GIRDER 格拉德 Corsa press-fit T700/T800 105 alloy wheels
why_interesting: GIRDER's lowest-priced official carbon disc road complete: the earlier T700 + T800 CORSA with 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12 and alloy wheels at ¥7,999, distinct from the 2025 CORSA with carbon wheels.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12; FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm crank, cassette written 'CS-7100' 11-34T, YBN 12-speed chain
facts.brakes: Shimano 105 R7120 hydraulic disc, 160 mm Center Lock rotors front and rear
facts.frame: ROAD-section CORSA T700 + T800 carbon 'integrated' frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully internal routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: Press-fit shell per manufacturer; the supplied in-house ceramic-bearing BB (19 G5 silicon-nitride balls) is described as 'PF386 to T47 tool compatible', so confirm the exact shell standard before ordering parts
facts.wheels: Aluminium rims, bearing disc hubs, Center Lock rotors
facts.tires: Maxxis M203 700C×28C fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 + T800 integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing; silicone bar tape
facts.sizes: S (448 mm), M (459 mm), L (497 mm); the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
